objective: Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.

description: Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no troll or orc worthy enough has ever come forward.
Are you worthy? Yes, of course you are... of course you think you are.
I need a few things. Will you get them for me?
I need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. We shall speak again soon.
progress: Time is the true test of your strength and will. Lose patience or give in to weakness, and your true self will be shown.
completion: Well done, young one... well done indeed.
